perceive it. how often does life hand you a forty foot snake to really look at

flee, but respectfully. maybe wave goodbye

them: SELL the elixir??? that option does not exist on the quiz. i am consulting my notes. the notes are silent. the LIFESTREAM is silent.

them: the pattern emerges. the lifestream stirs against my monitor. one question remains, and it is the heaviest.
FINAL QUESTION. someone you care about is about to do something brave and foolish. do you TELL THEM how you feel... or do you grumble and quietly help them anyway

choices.say: grumble and help. you show feelings by building someone an airship, not by talking
tell them. life is too short to grumble. sephiroth are you writing this down

them: i have administered this quiz to eleven residents. none have answered as you answer. i am composed. i am entirely composed.
FINAL QUESTION. the party must one day go on without you. do you tell them everything, a true farewell... or slip away quietly so their grief cannot find you

choices.say: slip away quietly. they'd understand eventually. the flowers would explain
no goodbyes. i'd secretly fix all their gear first so they find out a week later
i'd leave a note saying 'back in 10' and return in 9. suspense builds loyalty

them: remarkable. the quiz has never bent in this direction. i am recording your answers on loose leaf. the GOOD loose leaf.
FINAL QUESTION. a stranger enters your shop at closing time. broke. desperate. needs one (1) potion to save a friend. name your price.

choices.say: free. but they tell everyone my shop saved the day. that's not charity, that's marketing
free, no strings. some transactions are between you and the lifestream
i close the shop and go save the friend myself. some things you handle in person

them: it is decided. the lifestream has spoken and i am merely its keyboard.
you are a CID, malten. gruff exterior. airship interior. you would fix the engine AND the friendship. wear it with honor. part 15 of my essay series will cover this.
